title: A theory of noisy linear recurrent neural network learning dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.35785v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Biological neural networks are noisy: their dynamics involve difficult-to-predict fluctuations which are likely due not just to chaos, but also to a variety of low-level biophysical processes. Despite the omnipresence of intrinsic noise, its theoretical consequences are incompletely understood, especially in the context of learning. For example, does noise meaningfully shape representation learning, or is it better viewed as a nuisance factor whose presence or absence changes little about what solution is found and when? Here, we argue that intrinsic noise can significantly modulate representation learning in recurrent neural networks (RNNs), since it can strongly break solution-space degeneracies and in some cases control whether a non-degenerate solution exists at all. translated_title: 噪声线性循环神经网络学习动力学理论
translated_abstract: 生物神经网络是有噪声的：其动力学包含难以预测的涨落，这些涨落可能不仅源于混沌，还源于各种低层次的生物物理过程。尽管内在噪声无处不在，但其理论后果尚未被充分理解，尤其是在学习的背景下。例如，噪声是否真正有意义地塑造了表征学习，还是最好将其视为一种干扰因素——它的存在与否对找到什么样的解以及何时找到几乎没有影响？在本文中，我们论证了内在噪声可以显著调节循环神经网络（RNN）中的表征学习，因为它能够强烈地打破解空间的简并性，并且在某些情况下决定是否根本存在非简并解。我们证明，对于一个具有线性激活函数和白噪声输入的可解析求解的噪声RNN学习模型，这一结论是成立的。
tldr: 本文提出了一个可解析求解的噪声线性循环神经网络学习动力学理论，证明内在噪声并非无关干扰，而是能打破解空间简并性、从而显著塑造循环神经网络表征学习的关键因素。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an analytically tractable theory of noisy linear RNN learning dynamics, showing that intrinsic noise is not merely a nuisance but can significantly shape representation learning by breaking solution-space degeneracies and sometimes determining whether a non-degenerate solution exists at all.
